_README: Copy this file to 'my-data.local.json' (same folder) and put your real numbers in. That filename is gitignored (*.local.json) and is auto-loaded only in `npm run dev` when no saved state exists — it is never committed and never deployed. The easiest way to generate it: fill the form in the browser, click 'Export JSON', and save the download here as my-data.local.json. All values are today's dollars; rates are fractions (0.07 = 7%).
